title: Local Authorities (Changes to Years of Ordinary Elections) (England) Order 2025
amendmentMotionNotes: Baroness Scott of Bybrook moved that this House regrets that the Local Authorities (Changes to Years of Ordinary Elections) (England) Order 2025, laid before the House on 11 February, damages the democratic accountability of local authorities to local residents, and has not been subject to full and proper consultation (SI 2025/137). The House divided:
